source: ترجمة آلية أعدّها Claude لنص: التفسير الميسّر (الجزء بعد علامة [التفسير])
translator: Claude (Anthropic) — غير مراجَعة من مترجم بشري
scopeNote: ترجمة للتفسير فقط؛ لا تُترجم الآيات القرآنية. الأصل العربي الحرفي هو المرجع.

tafsir.muyassar-1: God swears by time, because of the wonders of His power in it that point to His greatness, that the children of Adam are in loss and decline. It is not permissible for a servant to swear except by God; swearing by other than God is polytheism.
tafsir.muyassar-2: God swears by time, because of the wonders of His power in it that point to His greatness, that the children of Adam are in loss and decline. It is not permissible for a servant to swear except by God; swearing by other than God is polytheism.
tafsir.muyassar-3: Except those who believed in God and did righteous deeds, and urged one another to hold fast to the truth, to act in obedience to God, and to be patient in that.
